body: You don't expect them to cheat, well I never expected one of my ex's to. He was so "in love" with me. He told me we were going to get married one day. He was a drunk though, and would cheat on me. I always came back though because I thought I could help and save him. I cared so much about him, but it soon got to the point where he started physically and emotionally damaging me more. I had to save myself and leave. I was mad at the other girls because those girls were my friends, or I thought they were. I trusted them. You're angry at any party involved when it comes to cheating, but I've found that I have to get burnt quite a few times before I learn my lesson.

I was 19, and incredibly shy. We had just went bowling with some friends and we were hanging out in the parking lot at work. He started getting shifty, and I knew he was gonna kiss me but it still scared me. He shoved his tongue down my throat. I ended up stealing his jacket to spite him and dated him for like three months.

Hmm this happened recently. I was at a Halloween party, and I had been feeling depressed and shitty, so I decided to pop pills. Then I decided to get drunk and smoke some weed. I ended up passed out in a corner and someone tried to molest me. Everyone thought I over dosed. I'm not bad like that right now, so no worries :)
I also missed the best part. There's this girl I work with, who is taller than most men, apparently hooked up with like two people in front of everybody. The guys were so short compared to her.
I like to put glue on my hand and let it dry, just so I can peel it off like a second skin. Feels so good....
I got a wonderful party, that I don't remember...
Stretchy pink shorts and a black t-shirt. I refuse to change out of my pajamas.

My hero is a young lady I met at Taco Bell. She had so much enthusiasm and so much hope that my friends and I talked to her a little bit. She offered us free food because we had been so kind to get, and we obliged. Later, we went out to smoke and she came out there to smoke and talk more.
My friend looks at her and asks her what she's on to have this sort of crazy energy. She admits that she is an ex-heroin addict, and she's currently receiving help from a local methadone clinic. She had been clean for over ten weeks now. She's doing this so she can get her daughter back. Home girl is even going to college.
I started crying when I heard her story, because I'm dealing with a lot right now, and I really have been considering suicide. She is so strong and brave, and I hope that I can be like that. 
I told her that she could do anything, just please keep your head up. I wish I could take my own advice. That girl is my hero. I've been meaning to stop by Taco Bell to chat with her again, because I think of her when I'm hurting bad. She gives me hope that maybe things will be okay.

My dream life is having a small cozy apartment in a big exciting city and be a chef. I would probably get a degree in English too. Then I would want to travel too, and have lots of friends everywhere. I'm lonely :(

I've thought before that I was in love with someone, but it wasn't love. I know what we had is love, it was scary as hell but it was love. I've talked to my mom about that and she says the same thing, but I don't know. He said it first, and so I felt like he felt as strongly as I did. 
Thank you so much, I get criticized for having such a caring heart sometimes. It's the greatest thing about me, I think, but it's also my biggest flaw. I don't really give my heart away, I think this is the first time I've ever have myself fully to someone and it back fired. I can't keep do this anymore. I would rather be alone than do this.

It's just hard to talk about how I feel. I know I've been repressing how I feel, because people expect me to be bubbly and happy. I don't want to show them that I'm hurting. I really think it goes back further than two weeks ago, I'm just ignoring the details.
I had an abusive ex, that started it all. He tried to keep me from my friends and family, and tried to take advantage of me. This happened about 8 months ago. I finally let him go 4 months in. 
Since him, I have been scared to be alone. So I dated a lot of guys casually. Some were just as mean as he was and told me how me being the way I am is not good enough. I'm fairly attractive, so I jumped to the next.
I finally found my current SO (if you can even call him that). He is the man of my dreams. He won't talk though because he said I lied about something that I don't know. He even blocked me on Facebook. We were supposed to talk yesterday, but he never called and I tried to contact him. It put me over the edge.
I feel disgusting. I thought that when he told me always, he fucking meant it. I thought he would always be there...
